Amazon's cost of sales rose about 38% from fiscal Q1 2023 to fiscal Q4 2023. This is an estimate: I could not recall the exact quarterly cost-of-sales figures, so I reconstructed them.

I worked from Amazon's reported fiscal 2023 totals and quarterly operating results. These are recalled from memory, not checked against the filings.

- Full-year 2023 cost of sales was about $304.7 billion.
- Q1 2023 cost of sales was roughly $67 billion, based on total operating expenses of about $122.6 billion less roughly $55–56 billion of other operating expenses.
- Q4 2023 cost of sales was roughly $93 billion, based on total operating expenses of about $156.8 billion less roughly $63 billion of other operating expenses.

The change is about (93 − 67) / 67 ≈ +38%.
